what_to_detect: A permanent returned by unearth that would leave the battlefield moves from the battlefield to exile instead, in the resolution (or the state-based check after it) that makes it leave.
near_miss: A permanent printing unearth that was not returned by unearth leaves the battlefield for its owner's graveyard or another zone other than exile.
note: The exile-instead replacement lives on Forge's command-zone 'Unearth Effect', no line of the creature, and the scenario's kind is resolution, so rewrite_event (rewrite records) is out; without a subject filter outcome_event tags every battlefield-to-exile move in the corpus (Swords to Plowshares, flicker, O-ring) as this rule.

what_to_detect: A creature returned by unearth this turn is listed among the legal attackers, because the unearth effect gives it haste.
near_miss: A creature printing unearth that came under its controller's control this turn without unearth is outside the legal attackers.
note: legality_membership has no filter on the listed entity, so legal_attackers inside tags every legal attacker in the corpus as this rule.
